override.repo_standard: CREW_CONTEXT Data Semantics: 'Session, season, round, driver, constructor, circuit and phase identities must be unambiguous' and time-dependent inputs need an explicit as-of cutoff (no None-means-latest).

override.repo_standard: Landed fingerprint/utilization API convention: channels and class_ids are plain str keys (FINGERPRINT_CHANNELS, vocabulary.class_ids); columns keyed by str.
override.reason: The script composes landed pieces and must key on the exact same string identities they expose; introducing wrapper value-objects here would diverge from the composed API for no correctness gain.
